legacy.full_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: an existing original cartoon SNES fighting-game transparent 4x4 atlas.
Input Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: Reston's current sixteen-pose atlas. Input Image 2 is the user's PHOTO REFERENCE for his short hair only.
Primary request: correct the too-bald native sprite reading. In ALL SIXTEEN figures give Reston visibly fuller, continuous very short near-black buzz-cut hair over the TOP and CROWN, extending the frontal hairline a modest amount forward. Keep a mature moderately high/receding forehead, but eliminate the broad bare orange scalp dome and thin rear-only hair cap. The top and forward crown must be a clearly defined dark charcoal/near-black mass using the same dark tones as his beard; not wispy brown/gray texture that disappears when shrunk to 96x80. The reference man has short hair over his head, not a shaved bald top. Preserve his closely cropped sides and his mature broad face, brows, nose and full trimmed black beard. No long hair, bangs, pompadour, youthful low hairline or different face.
STRICT INVARIANTS: Edit ONLY scalp hair and its immediate hairline in each existing pose. Retain exact 1254x1254 RGBA transparent canvas, regular 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen separate full-body figures, all positions, pose order, sizes, anatomy, body/head silhouette, foot baselines and right-facing orientation. Preserve copper-orange jacket, cream collar/cuffs, charcoal shirt, navy trousers, shoes and belt. Preserve existing outlines and original saturated 1993 arcade cartoon shading. Do not redraw or reinterpret limbs, clothes, poses, face or beard. Keep empty transparent gaps between every figure. Row4 col3 remains horizontal KO head left. No backgrounds, labels, grids, shadows, extra parts, effects, weapons, text or watermark.
The change must remain plainly visible at tiny SNES sprite resolution: a short dark cropped cap extending across the upper head rather than a bare forehead-to-crown dome. Keep all sixteen poses and canvas exactly as supplied. Genuine transparent background.
